title: Original Oven Roasted Argentinian Papelon Empanadas
description: A traditional Argentinian dish featuring papelon, these empanadas are perfect for a midnight craving, with a bitter and bouncy texture, and are nut-free friendly. They are made with a special ice-bath-shock technique to create the perfect crust.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, combine the flour and salt.
Add the butter to the flour mixture and mix until it forms a crumbly texture.
Gradually add the water to the mixture and mix until a dough forms.
Knead the dough for 5 minutes until it becomes smooth and elastic.
Divide the dough into 8 equal pieces and roll each piece into a ball.
Flatten each ball into a disk shape and place a tablespoon of papelon in the center of each disk.
Fold the dough over the papelon to form a triangle and press the edges together to seal the empanada.
Place the empanadas on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper and brush with beaten eggs.
Bake the empanadas in the preheated oven for 20 minutes or until golden brown.
Remove the empanadas from the oven and immediately submerge them in an ice bath to stop the cooking process.
